free_tier.stated: anonymous guest read of 8 root entries; no account and no payment

per_object_cap.stated: the upstream provider's cap; the instance publishes none

retention.stated: until the operator's account or tenant fails; no TTL and no notice

egress.terms: served through cloudflare; the reader pays nothing

tooling: the AList/OpenList REST surface (/api/fs/list, /api/fs/get, /api/fs/put) and the WebDAV endpoint at /dav; the rclone alist backend speaks the REST
chaining: a fetch substrate: point a cache and two mirrors at it, never a write tier Read-only. Its value is as a template and as a fetch source, and it demonstrates that an instance with allow_mounted true exposes the mounted provider through the API, which is how to identify which pan backs a site without an account

limits.value: PUT denied at the guest role

identity_cost.detail: no registration; /api/me returns a guest session

reliability_note: An anime index on an AList v3.23 build from about 2022, which makes it one of the two oldest instances still listing. base_path is /新番/anime/new, so / in the API is not the instance root. Read-only by design.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, JSON carrying a code field, site_title 'Alist追番'
anonymous POST /api/fs/list on / returned code 200 with 8 root entries; write:false, write_content_bypass:None, provider:GoogleDrive
the zero-byte oracle (PUT at an existing directory with Overwrite:false) returned code 403 with message 'permission denied' inside HTTP 200, so the write permission failed and nothing was written

seed_facts.quota_verbatim: No stated quota. Eight root collections of current-season anime on a GoogleDrive backend, sub-directories modified 2026-10-05
seed_facts.chaining_verbatim: Read-only. Its value is as a template and as a fetch source, and it demonstrates that an instance with allow_mounted true exposes the mounted provider through the API, which is how to identify which pan backs a site without an account
seed_facts.reliability_verbatim: Alive, small and single-maintainer. Anonymous WebDAV GET returns a 302 to the origin link, so ranged reads must follow redirects
seed_facts.tooling_verbatim: AList WebDAV at https://zhuifan.link/dav/ with two published guest credentials that both work, zhuifan:zhuifan and guest:guest, plus the anonymous REST API. rclone webdav applies
seed_facts.binding_note_verbatim: The read path works and is free. What binds is that no write is accepted, so the instance can only ever serve somebody else's bytes, and a serving path with no capacity behind it is a fetch source rather than storage.
